content.value: A 230V dc shunt motor has an armature resistance of 0.5Ω and field resistance of 115Ω. At no (10) load, the speed is 1200 rpm and the armature current is 2.5A. On application of rated load, the speed drops to 1120 rpm. Determine the line current and power input when the motor delivers rated load.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2020
